svg.title: Who saved Sappho: the writers who quoted her
svg.desc: Lines join each later Greek writer to the Sappho fragments he quotes, as printed by Wharton (1908), with the 12 writers who quote most listed by name and count (Hephaestion 23, Athenaeus 20, Apollonius Dyscolus 17, ...) and 43 other writers grouped. Marker shapes give the kind of writer: metrician, grammarian or lexicon, anthology, critic, scholiast, philosopher, other. Educational demos made to show an open-source tool. Not research.
